    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_DateMerge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDateToWait" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Event_WaitFriendReplies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToDateCheck" sourceRef="Event_WaitFriendReplies" targetRef="Gateway_DateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateConfirmed" name="Yes: 8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotConfirmed" name="No: appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGamesToCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Yes: some missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesCheck" targetRef="UserTask_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesComplete" name="No: all available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesCheck" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge" sourceRef="UserTask_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEstimateBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Task_EstimateBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EstimateToBeerCheck" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing" name="Not enough" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="UserTask_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToBeerMerge" sourceRef="UserTask_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANPartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PlanningStarted" name="LAN party planning started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToInvitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToInvitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvitationsToCollectGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectGames" name="Find out which games friends want to play">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvitationsToCollectGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectGamesToWaitList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitGamesList" name="Wait until list of games is received from friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectGamesToWaitList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitListToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_GamesList"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Plan date and check games in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitListToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToDateMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCheckGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- Branch A: date planning -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateMerge" name="Date planning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToDateMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateNotConfirmed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AppointDateToWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitFriendReplies" name="Wait until friends have replied on availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AppointDateToWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitToDateCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_FriendReplies"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateCheck" name="8 or more people agree on date?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitToDateCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateConfirmed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateNotConfirmed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Branch B: games check -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check which games are already owned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCheckGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckGamesToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesCheck" name="Games missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckGamesToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMissing</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMissing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMergeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Synchronization of both branches -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join" name="Date and games settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateConfirmed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMergeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToEstimateBeer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- Beer planning -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EstimateBeer" name="Find out how much beer is required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToEstimateBeer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EstimateToBeerCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerCheck" name="Enough beer?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EstimateToBeerCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMissing</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerEnough</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMissing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyToBeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Beer ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyToBeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerEnough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Enjoyment and end -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnjoyToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LANPartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnjoyToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToInvitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanningStarted" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvitationsToCollectGames" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CollectGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectGamesToWaitList" sourceRef="Task_CollectGames" targetRef="Event_WaitGamesList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitListToSplit" sourceRef="Event_WaitGamesList" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDateMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_DateMerge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDateToWait" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Event_WaitFriendReplies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToDateCheck" sourceRef="Event_WaitFriendReplies" targetRef="Gateway_DateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateConfirmed" name="Yes: 8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotConfirmed" name="No: appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGamesToCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Yes: some missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesCheck" targetRef="UserTask_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesComplete" name="No: all available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesCheck" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge" sourceRef="UserTask_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEstimateBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Task_EstimateBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EstimateToBeerCheck" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing" name="Not enough" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="ManualTask_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToBeerMerge" sourceRef="ManualTask_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANPartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that after checking whether an available amount is sufficient, a shortfall must be remedied by an action the process participant performs (such as buying or obtaining more), before the process continues: Model the insufficient branch of the exclusive gateway that checks the amount as a user task performed by the participant who obtains the shortfall, placed on that branch. Route its outgoing flow into the merge of the two branches before the next step. Do not connect the insufficient branch directly to the merge or to the next step, and do not model the acquisition as an intermediate event.
rules.situation: the description says that after checking whether an available amount is sufficient, a shortfall must be remedied by an action the process participant performs (such as buying or obtaining more), before the process continues

rules.instruction: When the description says that after a step the process must wait for a stated duration or until other parties reply, and a later decision or step depends on the outcome of that wait: Model the wait as an intermediate catch event on the sequence flow directly after the step that starts the wait and before the gateway or task that uses its outcome. Label the event with the stated duration or the condition being waited for. Do not drop the wait or fold it into the preceding task.
rules.situation: the description says that after a step the process must wait for a stated duration or until other parties reply, and a later decision or step depends on the outcome of that wait

rules.instruction: When the description says the participant keeps waiting, phrased as 'until' some group has replied or until the participant has gathered everything needed, before the next decision or join can proceed: Model that waiting period as an intermediate catch event (a message catch when it waits for replies from other people, a timer when it waits for a stated duration) placed in the sequence where the description places the wait, before the decision or join that depends on its outcome. Do not model the wait as a task, and do not drop it.
rules.situation: the description says the participant keeps waiting, phrased as 'until' some group has replied or until the participant has gathered everything needed, before the next decision or join can proceed

rules.instruction: When the description says that after a quantity has been collected from others, a decision checks whether there is a shortfall, and that a stated corrective action (such as obtaining the remainder) must be performed in the shortfall case before the process continues: Model the decision as an exclusive gateway after the step that establishes the quantity. Give the shortfall branch its own task, labeled with the corrective action the description states, and route the sufficient case directly to the merge. Rejoin both branches before the next step. Do not omit the corrective task, fold it into a flow condition, or merge it into the gateway.
rules.situation: the description says that after a quantity has been collected from others, a decision checks whether there is a shortfall, and that a stated corrective action (such as obtaining the remainder) must be performed in the shortfall case before the process continues

rules.instruction: When the description says that a check of a required quantity is performed and that, when the check finds the quantity insufficient, a concrete acquisition action must follow before the process continues: Model the acquisition action as a task on the branch where the check fails, placed before that branch merges back into the main flow. Do not omit this task, and do not treat the check gateway as the only step on that branch.
rules.situation: the description says that a check of a required quantity is performed and that, when the check finds the quantity insufficient, a concrete acquisition action must follow before the process continues
